base_mesh: assets/library/source/cat-fripouille/ (Sketchfab download of "3d modelling my cat: Fripouille", CC-BY-4.0)
edits: Modified by GTEki contributors: whiskers removed, mesh decimated, recoloured solid blue-grey with vertex colours (textures removed), bones renamed, ear bones added and reweighted, animation clips authored.

Source repair: 0.01 unit fix and canonical axis map, yawed nose onto +Y, centred on the spine, scaled to 0.345 m bind height, feet on z = 0; the source joints are a posed skeleton inconsistent with the bind mesh, so joint positions were re-derived from the weighted mesh regions, and the eyes were re-placed by similarity onto the head
Eyes recoloured from SHD_eye_baseColor.png (luma < 0.15 -> pupil #141210, else iris #3A9A52); coat #5B626B, nose leather #6E6468; one material, roughness 1, metallic 0
clip_authorship: Authored by GTEki contributors in Blender from code (no motion capture, no third-party clips): idle, sit, walk, trot, run, start, stop, turn_l, turn_r at 30 fps
generator: tools/blender/character/build_cat_fripouille.py, Blender 5.2.3 LTS (headless, -b) with the bundled glTF 2.0 exporter
budget: one mesh, one primitive, one material, no images; <=5000 triangles (body 4170, eyes 388), <=1.2 MB GLB, <=40 joints (30)
